name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=ui shop dialog). Descriptor accurately reflects purpose: opens the shop dialog panel with a 6-frame slide-down reveal. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Open the shop dialog panel with a 6-frame slide-down reveal animation (composites the shop-title sprite and item grid into a full-screen buffer, then slides it down over the saved framebuffer).
logic_summary: Allocates three 64000-byte (320x200) workspace globals (anim_accumulator, bg_snapshot, composed_target). memmove copies the live framebuffer at 0xA0000 into bg_snapshot, then bg_snapshot into composed_target (composite starts as the current screen). Blits the shop-title sprite (atlas entry at offset 0x46) into composed_target at mode-13h offset 0x8C05 via fd2_dialog_sprite_blit_normal. Renders the item grid into composed_target via fd2_render_shop_item_grid using the current cursor (data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx) and sell_mode_flag masked to its low byte. Then runs a 6-iteration countdown loop (frame_iter 5->0) computing panel_y = frame_iter*0xD + 0x70 (0xB1,0xA4,0x97,0x8A,0x7D,0x70) and calling fd2_slide_panel_down_step(panel_y, anim_accumulator, composed_target) each frame, producing the slide-down reveal. Companion open-side counterpart to fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out @ 0x2D31B, which frees these buffers and restores bg_snapshot.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_open_shop_dialog_panel(uint32 item_count, uint8 *item_id_array, uint32 sell_mode_flag)

params.name: item_count
params.semantics: Number of items to render in the shop grid; forwarded unchanged to fd2_render_shop_item_grid as the row count.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value (item count for the grid); no address residue.

params.name: item_id_array
params.semantics: Pointer to the byte array of item ids displayed in the grid; forwarded unchanged to fd2_render_shop_item_grid.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value (byte array of item ids); no address residue.

params.name: sell_mode_flag
params.semantics: Render-mode selector: 0 for the buy menu, 1 for the sell/give menus (call sites fd2_run_buy_item_menu pass 0; fd2_run_sell_item_menu / fd2_run_give_item_menu pass 1). Passed to fd2_render_shop_item_grid masked to its low byte (sell_mode_flag & 0xFF).
params.reason: Accurately describes the value (sell-vs-buy render-mode flag); no address residue. Caller analysis confirms the 0/1 buy/sell semantics.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects only (allocates the three slide buffers and paints/animates the panel onto VGA).

comment_original_issue: Source comment block was already accurate and precise, but contained three non-ASCII em-dash characters (U+2014) on the workspace-globals bullet lines, violating the code-internal ASCII-only rule.
notes: Plate comment (Ghidra) is detailed and fully consistent with the refined source comment; left unchanged (plate=none). Only edit to src was converting 3 em-dashes (--) to ASCII in this function's comment block; function logic/signature/types untouched. Caller decompile (fd2_run_buy_item_menu) plus source call sites at shop.c:295/540/758 confirm sell_mode_flag 0=buy, 1=sell/give.
